notes._readme: MCP Server configuration for accra-rentals project

available_servers.stripe: claude mcp add --transport http stripe https://mcp.stripe.com
available_servers.sentry: claude mcp add --transport http sentry https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp
available_servers.slack: claude mcp add --transport http slack https://mcp.slack.com (requires OAuth)
available_servers.notion: claude mcp add --transport http notion https://mcp.notion.com
available_servers.postgres: claude mcp add --transport stdio postgres -- npx -y @bytebase/dbhub --dsn 'postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/db'
